limitations: Semantic labels are not geometry measurements.
No canonical facial landmarks are present in schema version 1.0.
Placement rectangles can be validated, but witness similarity cannot be inferred.
Provisional labels require forensic-artist or domain-expert review.

issues.message: No canonical landmark or measured face-geometry schema is defined; short-vs-long or proportion-aware matching cannot be validated.
Semantic component labels remain provisional and require domain-expert review.
All catalogue components remain provisional; no domain-expert-reviewed component is recorded.
